colophene.def: (chemistry) A colorless oily liquid, formerly obtained by distillation of colophony (rosin), regarded as a polymeric form of terebenthene.

eicosanoid.def: any of a family of naturally-occurring substances derived from 20-carbon polyunsaturated fatty acids; they include the prostaglandins, thromboxanes, leukotrienes and epoxyeicosatrienoic acids; they function as hormones.

cytosine.def: a heterocyclic base, 4-aminopyrimidin-2(1H)-one, which pairs with guanine in DNA and RNA (by means of three hydrogen bonds).

authigenic.def: generated where it is found or observed.

nemaline.def: having the form of threads; fibrous.

lochage.def: the head of a lochos in Ancient Greece; an officer or commander. .mw-parser-output .defdate{font-size:smaller}
